module.purpose: Manages the complete lifecycle of a database collection including state transitions, garbage collection scheduling, idle-time cleanup, and readiness signaling for a reactive collection system.
module.summary: This file implements CollectionLifecycleManager, a class that orchestrates collection state transitions (idle, loading, ready, error, cleaned-up) with strict validation rules. It handles garbage collection scheduling via CleanupQueue, performs non-blocking cleanup during browser idle time using idle callbacks, and provides callbacks for first-ready notifications. The manager coordinates between indexes, events, changes, sync, and state managers to maintain collection integrity.
module.businessContext: Ensures collection state integrity in a reactive database system. Invalid state transitions could corrupt data, leak memory through unreleased resources, or cause application crashes during collection operations.

detail.name: performCleanup
preconditions: Called from scheduleIdleCleanup or equivalent; changes.activeSubscribersCount is 0 (checked by caller)
postconditions: When returns true: this.sync.cleanup(), this.state.cleanup(), this.changes.cleanup(), and this.indexes.cleanup() have all been invoked
When returns false: cleanup was not performed because no idle time was available and must be rescheduled
edgeCases: deadline is undefined (no IdleCallbackDeadline): always treats as having time, performs full cleanup immediately
deadline.timeRemaining() > 0: has time, performs full cleanup immediately
deadline.timeRemaining() <= 0 and deadline.didTimeout is true: still proceeds with full cleanup
deadline.timeRemaining() <= 0 and deadline.didTimeout is false: no time available, returns false without performing cleanup
stateMutations: Delegates to this.sync.cleanup(), this.state.cleanup(), this.changes.cleanup(), this.indexes.cleanup() which each mutate their respective subsystem state
detail.summary: Performs all collection cleanup operations (sync, state, changes, indexes) in a single pass when idle time is available. Returns true if cleanup completed, false if it must be rescheduled for a later idle period.
